mismatches.reason: The predicate only constrains swap fees above the factory threshold to be at most max_fee_cap, not that the threshold is aligned with MAX_FEE_CAP.
The predicate encodes a fee exceeding the threshold and max cap, not the system falling back to basic tick spacing fees.
I does not express threshold alignment with MAX_FEE_CAP, and V does not encode fallback to basic tick spacing fees, so V is not a direct violation of I under P.
